title: Daily set · Nov 20
title_zh: 每日新题 · 11 月 20 日
summary: Five new agent questions: tool results cut without saying so, moving from Vertex AI to Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), retrieval across languages, model comparisons polluted by refusal fallbacks, and erasing a shopper's data from an agent platform.
summary_zh: 五道新的 Agent 题：被悄悄截断的工具结果、从 Vertex AI 迁移到 Claude Models on Google Cloud（Anthropic managed）、跨语言检索、被拒答回退污染的模型对比，以及从 Agent 平台中删除一位顾客的数据。

questions.title: The finance agent reports last month's revenue from the first 100 orders, because the harness cuts large tool results without saying so
questions.title_zh: 财务 Agent 只根据前 100 笔订单就报出了上个月的收入，因为框架在不作说明的情况下截断了过大的工具结果
questions.question:
A merchant asks the finance agent for last month's revenue. Its `list_orders` tool returns every matching order as JSON, and to protect the context window the harness keeps only the first 100 KB of any tool result. For a store with 4,000 orders the agent receives about 600 of them, adds them up, and states a confident total that is far too low. Nothing in the result told the model it was incomplete.

Explain the failure and redesign the tool.
questions.question_zh:
一位商家向财务 Agent 询问上个月的收入。它的 `list_orders` 工具会以 JSON 返回所有匹配的订单，而为了保护上下文窗口，框架对任何工具结果只保留前 100 KB。对一个有 4,000 笔订单的店铺，Agent 大约只拿到了其中 600 笔，把它们加起来，然后信心十足地报出了一个低得多的总额。结果里没有任何信息告诉模型数据不完整。

解释这个故障，并重新设计这个工具。
followups: The merchant asks for revenue by country and by product. One tool, or several?
How would you detect in production that answers were built on partial data?
followups_zh: 商家想按国家和按商品查看收入。用一个工具，还是几个？
在生产环境中，你会如何发现答案是基于不完整的数据得出的？

questions.title: Moving the catalog agent from Vertex AI to Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed): model IDs, workspaces, keys and the EU endpoint
questions.title_zh: 把商品目录 Agent 从 Vertex AI 迁移到 Claude Models on Google Cloud（Anthropic managed）：模型 ID、workspace、key 和欧盟端点
questions.question:
The catalog agent calls Claude through Vertex AI with the `AnthropicVertex` client in the `europe-west4` region. The team wants Claude API features that Vertex lacks and decides to move to Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), still billed through Google. In the first test, requests fail before they are sent, the old model ID `claude-opus-4-5@20251101` is rejected, an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` the team exported has no effect, and batches and uploaded files from their existing Claude Console organization are missing.

Explain each surprise and plan the move.
questions.question_zh:
商品目录 Agent 通过 Vertex AI 调用 Claude，用的是 `europe-west4` 区域的 `AnthropicVertex` 客户端。团队想用 Vertex 上没有的 Claude API 功能，于是决定迁移到 Claude Models on Google Cloud（Anthropic managed），计费仍然走 Google。第一次测试中：请求在发出之前就失败了；旧模型 ID `claude-opus-4-5@20251101` 被拒绝；团队导出的 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 没有任何作用；他们现有 Claude Console 组织里的批处理任务和上传文件也都找不到了。

解释每个意外，并规划这次迁移。
followups: A teammate's IAM role is revoked, but their Managed Agents session keeps running. Why, and how do you stop it?
How would you test the new platform without moving production traffic?
followups_zh: 某位同事的 IAM 角色被撤销了，但他的 Managed Agents 会话还在运行。为什么？如何停止它？
在不迁移生产流量的情况下，你会如何测试新平台？

questions.title: German and Japanese merchants get vague answers from the help assistant, although the right article exists in English and in their language
questions.title_zh: 德国和日本商家从帮助助手那里得到的答案很含糊，尽管英文和他们母语的正确文章都存在
questions.question:
The help center has about 2,000 English articles and partial translations in German and Japanese. The assistant embeds the merchant's question as written and retrieves the top five chunks from one shared index. English questions do well; German and Japanese questions often retrieve loosely related chunks, the answers are vague, and the citations sometimes point to an outdated German translation of an article whose English version was updated last week.

Diagnose the problem and redesign retrieval for multiple languages.
questions.question_zh:
帮助中心有大约 2,000 篇英文文章，以及部分德文和日文译文。助手按原文对商家的问题做向量化，然后从一个共享索引中检索前五个片段。英文问题效果很好；德文和日文问题却经常检索到关联不大的片段，答案含糊，引用有时还指向某篇文章过时的德文译文，而它的英文版上周刚更新过。

诊断问题，并为多语言重新设计检索。
followups: How would you choose between a multilingual embedding model and query translation?
A German term has no English equivalent in the help center. What happens, and what do you do?
followups_zh: 你会如何在多语言向量模型和问题翻译之间做选择？
某个德文术语在帮助中心里没有对应的英文说法。会发生什么？你要怎么做？

questions.title: The model comparison says Claude Fable 5.1 beats Claude Opus 5.5 on ad-policy reviews, but some of Fable's answers were written by Claude Opus 4.8
questions.title_zh: 模型对比结果显示 Claude Fable 5.1 在广告政策审核上胜过 Claude Opus 5.5，但 Fable 的部分答案其实是 Claude Opus 4.8 写的
questions.question:
The team compares Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 for an ad-policy review agent on 300 cases, three repetitions each. The production code enables server-side refusal fallbacks, and the eval calls the production entry point, so fallbacks are on in the eval too. Fable 5.1 wins by a few points. A reviewer notices that some Fable rows mention `claude-opus-4-8` in the response, that the cost per case looks too low, and that the second and third repetitions of some cases never touched Fable at all.

Explain what the eval actually measured and fix it.
questions.question_zh:
团队用 300 个用例、每个重复三次，比较 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Claude Opus 5.5 在广告政策审核 Agent 上的表现。生产代码开启了服务端的拒答回退（fallbacks），而评测调用的是生产入口，所以评测里也开着回退。Fable 5.1 领先几个百分点。一位审阅者注意到：有些 Fable 的结果行在响应中出现了 `claude-opus-4-8`；每个用例的成本看起来低得不对；还有些用例的第二、第三次重复根本没有用到 Fable。

解释这个评测实际测到了什么，并修复它。
followups: How would you stop sticky routing from affecting repetitions in an eval?
Which refusal categories would you expect on ad-policy cases, and how would you report them?
Where else in an eval can the served model differ from the requested one?
followups_zh: 你会如何避免粘性路由影响评测中的重复运行？
在广告政策用例上，你预计会出现哪些拒答类别？你会如何报告它们？
在评测中，还有哪些地方实际服务的模型可能与请求的不同？

questions.title: A shopper asks to have their data deleted, and it is spread across agent sessions, memory history, uploaded files, traces and eval sets
questions.title_zh: 一位顾客要求删除自己的数据，而这些数据分散在 Agent 会话、记忆历史、上传文件、追踪数据和评测集里
questions.question:
A shopper invokes their right to erasure. The support agent on Managed Agents has handled their tickets for a year: their name, address and order details appear in session histories, in notes the agent wrote to a merchant's memory store, in a CSV of order disputes uploaded through the Files API, in OpenTelemetry traces with full content, and in eval cases the team copied from production transcripts. Legal asks the agent team for a plan and a deadline.

Design the deletion process and the changes that make the next request easier.
questions.question_zh:
一位顾客行使了被遗忘权。Managed Agents 上的客服 Agent 处理他的工单已经一年了：他的姓名、地址和订单详情出现在会话历史中、Agent 写进商家记忆库的笔记里、通过 Files API 上传的一份订单争议 CSV 中、带完整内容的 OpenTelemetry 追踪数据里，以及团队从生产对话记录中复制出来的评测用例里。法务要求 Agent 团队给出方案和完成期限。

设计删除流程，以及让下一次请求更容易处理的改进。
followups: The shopper's data appears inside a session that also holds other customers' tickets. What do you do?
How would you keep eval sets built from production transcripts free of personal data?
Which of these stores would you check first under a tight deadline, and why?
followups_zh: 这位顾客的数据出现在一个同时包含其他客户工单的会话中。你怎么办？
你会如何确保从生产对话记录构建的评测集里没有个人数据？
在期限很紧的情况下，你会先检查这些存储中的哪一个？为什么？
